# proxmox_guest_vnc_websocket (Data Source)

Resolves the VNC websocket port through `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/vncwebsocket`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_vnc_websocket" "qemu" {
  type       = "qemu"
  node       = "pve"
  vmid       = 100
  vnc_ticket = "PVE:root@pam:VNC_TICKET"
  port       = "5900"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `port` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)
- `vnc_ticket` (String, Sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result_port` (String)
